meta.title: JavaScript Pivot Table for React and Angular | AG Grid
meta.description: Pivot, group and aggregate data in a JavaScript data grid. AG Grid pivot mode, pivot panel, server-side pivoting, pivot charts and Excel export.
meta.demandSource: Google Ads search volume via DataForSEO (US, English, 12-month average), 2 October 2026

hero.heading: JavaScript pivot tables with AG Grid
hero.subHeading: AG Grid has a pivot mode built into the data grid. Users drag columns into row groups, values and column labels, and the grid generates the pivot result columns.

shortAnswer: AG Grid turns a data grid into a pivot table when you set `pivotMode=true`, group rows with `rowGroup`, aggregate a value column with `aggFunc` and set `pivot: true` on the column whose values become column headers. Users can change the layout themselves from the Side Bar or the Pivot Panel. Pivoting, aggregation, row grouping, pivot totals, server-side pivoting and Excel export are AG Grid Enterprise features, which need a paid licence. AG Grid Community, which is free, does not pivot. Pivot Charts come from Integrated Charts, built on AG Charts; enterprise chart types need the Enterprise Bundle. The same API works in React, Angular, Vue and plain JavaScript.

example.intro: Revenue by region, pivoted by quarter. Drag columns in the side bar or pivot panel to change the layout.

items.title: Pivot mode
items.body: `pivotMode=true` with pivot: true on a column turns that column's values into column headers. At least one aggregation column is required, as only aggregated rows are shown when pivoting.

items.title: Side Bar and Columns Tool Panel
items.body: `sideBar='columns'` adds a panel with a Pivot Mode toggle and Row Groups, Values and Column Labels sections that users fill by drag and drop. Columns need `enableRowGroup`, `enableValue` or `enablePivot`.

items.title: Pivot Panel
items.body: `pivotPanelShow` (`'always'`, `'onlyWhenPivoting'` or `'never'`) shows a bar above the grid where users add, remove and reorder pivot columns by drag and drop.

items.title: Aggregation
items.body: `aggFunc` on a column sets sum, min, max, count, avg, first, last or a custom function. Group and grand total rows can be added with `groupTotalRow` and `grandTotalRow`.

items.title: Pivot result columns
items.body: The grid generates a column for each unique combination of pivot values. They inherit the value column's definition, can be changed with `processPivotResultColDef` and capped with `pivotMaxGeneratedColumns`.

items.title: Pivot totals
items.body: Column group totals appear when a pivot column group is collapsed. `pivotRowTotals` set to `'before'` or `'after'` adds a total column for each aggregation.

items.title: Show Values As
items.body: Displays aggregated values as a share of the grand, column, row or parent total without changing the data. Requires ShowValuesAsModule and the client-side row model.

items.title: Server-side pivoting
items.body: With the Server-Side Row Model the grid sends `pivotCols` and `pivotMode` in each `getRows` request and your server does the pivot. Return `pivotResultFields`, or call `setPivotResultColumns`, to define the result columns.

items.title: Pivot Chart
items.body: In pivot mode the context menu gains a Pivot Chart item that charts all grouped and pivoted data with AG Charts. `gridApi.createPivotChart()` does the same from code. Enterprise chart types need the Enterprise Bundle.

items.title: Excel export
items.body: Exports the grid as rendered to .xlsx, including grouping and column header groups. Collapsed pivot result columns are not exported, even with `allColumns: true`.

howTo.heading: How to build a pivot table with AG Grid

steps.title: Install AG Grid Enterprise
steps.body: Install `ag-grid-react` and `ag-grid-enterprise`, then pass `[AllEnterpriseModule]`, or just `PivotModule` plus the modules you use, to `AgGridProvider`. Without a licence key the grid shows a watermark.

steps.title: Group rows and set a value column
steps.body: Set `rowGroup: true` on the column that forms the rows and `aggFunc: 'sum'` (or another function) on at least one value column.

steps.title: Turn on pivot mode
steps.body: Set `pivotMode` on the grid and `pivot: true` on the column whose values become column headers. The grid generates the pivot result columns.

steps.title: Let users change the pivot
steps.body: Add `sideBar="columns"` and `pivotPanelShow="always"`, and set `enableRowGroup`, `enablePivot` and `enableValue` on the columns users may drag.

steps.title: Add totals, charts and export
steps.body: Set `pivotRowTotals` and `grandTotalRow`, add `enableCharts` with `AllEnterpriseModule.with(AgChartsCommunityModule)` for Pivot Charts, and call `api.exportDataAsExcel()` to export.

howTo.outro: See the [main AG Grid demo](/example/), which registers pivoting and Integrated Charts: enter pivot mode, choose group, pivot and value columns, then open the context menu and pick a chart from the Pivot Chart sub menu.

faq.question: Is there an open-source JavaScript pivot table?
faq.answer: AG Grid Community is MIT licensed but does not include pivoting. Pivoting is in AG Grid Enterprise, whose source is public on GitHub but which requires a commercial licence for production use. You can test Enterprise locally without a key; the grid shows a watermark.

faq.question: Can a JavaScript pivot table export to Excel?
faq.answer: AG Grid Enterprise exports the grid to .xlsx as it is rendered, including row grouping and column header groups. In pivot mode only visible pivot result columns are exported; collapsed ones are left out even with `allColumns: true`.

faq.question: Where can I see a JavaScript pivot table example?
faq.answer: Each pivoting docs page includes runnable live examples, and the main demo at ag-grid.com/example supports pivot mode and Pivot Charts.

faq.question: Is pivoting free in AG Grid Community?
faq.answer: No. Pivoting, aggregation and row grouping are marked Enterprise on the AG Grid pricing page. Community includes sorting, filtering, editing and CSV export.

faq.question: Can AG Grid pivot large data sets on the server?
faq.answer: Yes, with the Server-Side Row Model. The grid sends the pivot columns and pivot mode in each request, your server runs the query, and the grid builds result columns from the `pivotResultFields` you return.

faq.question: How do I limit the number of pivot columns?
faq.answer: Set `pivotMaxGeneratedColumns`. When a pivot would generate more columns than that, the grid stops, clears the view and fires the `pivotMaxColumnsExceeded` event so your app can respond.

proseClaims.claim: Pivoting is an Enterprise feature enabled with pivotMode=true and pivot: true on a column, alongside rowGroup and aggFunc columns.
At least one aggregation column is required, as only aggregated rows are shown when pivoting.
Users can configure pivoting through the Side Bar or the Pivot Panel.
pivotPanelShow accepts 'always', 'onlyWhenPivoting' or 'never', and the Pivot Panel lets users reorder, remove or add pivot columns by drag and drop.
The Columns Tool Panel has a Pivot Mode toggle and Row Groups, Values and Column Labels sections; dragging into them needs enableRowGroup, enableValue or enablePivot.
There are seven built-in aggregation functions: sum, min, max, count, avg, first and last, and custom functions can be added.
Group and grand total rows are added with the groupTotalRow and grandTotalRow grid options.
Pivot result columns are generated for each unique permutation of pivot values, inherit the value column definition and can be changed with processPivotResultColDef.
When pivotMaxGeneratedColumns is exceeded the grid halts column generation, clears the view and fires the pivotMaxColumnsExceeded event.
Column group totals are shown when a pivot column group is collapsed, and pivotRowTotals set to 'before' or 'after' adds a total column for each aggregation.
Show Values As has five built-in modes, requires ShowValuesAsModule and is only supported with the Client-Side Row Model.
With the Server-Side Row Model, getRows requests include pivotCols and pivotMode, and result columns come from pivotResultFields or setPivotResultColumns.
Pivot Chart is an Enterprise feature: when pivot mode is active a Pivot Chart item appears in the context menu, and it charts all grouped and pivoted data.
Pivot Charts can be created from code with gridApi.createPivotChart().
The Pivot Chart docs suggest trying it on the main demo page: enter pivot mode, choose group, pivot and value columns, then pick a chart from the Pivot Chart context menu.
Without an Enterprise Bundle licence only Integrated Community charts, powered by AG Charts Community, are available.
AG Grid Community is MIT licensed; AG Grid Enterprise is open source but needs a commercial licence for production and can be tested locally without a key, showing a watermark.
Excel export follows the grid as rendered, including row grouping, and is an Enterprise feature.
Collapsed pivot result columns are not exported to Excel, even with allColumns: true.
Pivoting, Aggregation and Row Grouping are marked Enterprise on the pricing page, while Text, Number and Date filters, the Quick Filter, basic cell editors and CSV Export are Community.
